card.title: Automated activations on WhatsApp
card.excerpt: A WhatsApp bot that activates experiences, serves and chats with Michelob consumers around the clock.

paragraphs: Michelob wanted to connect with its community around its activations and events, without depending on business hours or handling every message by hand.
We built a digital coworker on WhatsApp that automates interactions: it activates experiences, answers questions and keeps the conversation going with every consumer around the clock.

challenge.label: Challenge
challenge.text: Connect with the community around activations without depending on business hours or manual support.

solution.label: Solution
solution.text: A conversational WhatsApp bot that automates activations, replies and experiences, available 24/7.

result.label: Result
result.text: A brand present at every activation, chatting with its consumers in real time at any hour.
